title_en: KALIA Scheme (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation - Odisha)
description_en: Groundbreaking agricultural welfare initiative by Government of Odisha providing comprehensive financial support to small farmers, marginal cultivators, and landless agricultural households.
description_hi: ओडिशा के छोटे, सीमांत और भूमिहीन खेतिहर मजदूरों को प्रति वर्ष ₹10,000 की प्रत्यक्ष कृषि एवं आजीविका सहायता।
benefits_en: Financial assistance of Rs 10,000 per family per year for farm inputs, Rs 12,500 for landless agricultural households for livestock micro-units, and Rs 2 Lakh life/disability insurance.
benefits_hi: कृषि इनपुट हेतु ₹10,000 प्रति वर्ष, भूमिहीन परिवारों को ₹12,500 आजीविका अनुदान तथा ₹2 लाख का निःशुल्क जीवन बीमा।
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural laborers of Odisha.
nodal_ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Empowerment, Odisha

description_en: Universal health protection scheme by Government of Odisha providing cashless healthcare in government health facilities and empanelled private hospitals across India.
description_hi: ओडिशा के परिवारों को ₹5 लाख (तथा परिवार की महिला सदस्यों हेतु ₹10 लाख) तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
benefits_en: Cashless hospitalization up to Rs 5 Lakh per family per year, and enhanced coverage of up to Rs 10 Lakh for women members of the family.
benefits_hi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख तथा महिलाओं हेतु ₹10 लाख प्रति वर्ष तक का पूर्ण कैशलेस उपचार।
eligibility_criteria: All BSKY Smart Health Card holders and BPL/ration card families residing in Odisha.
nodal_ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Odisha

description_en: Credit-linked housing initiative by Government of Odisha providing subsidized institutional bank loans and capital subsidies to rural families to construct or upgrade pucca houses.
description_hi: ओडिशा के ग्रामीण परिवारों को पक्का मकान बनाने या विस्तार करने हेतु ₹3 लाख तक का सस्ता बैंक ऋण और ₹60,000 तक की सरकारी सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: Housing loan up to Rs 3 Lakh with direct capital subsidy ranging from Rs 30,000 to Rs 60,000 (up to Rs 70,000 for SC/ST/Divyangjan).
benefits_hi: ₹3,00,000 तक का आवास ऋण और ₹60,000 से ₹70,000 तक की सीधी सरकारी सब्सिडी।
eligibility_criteria: Rural families of Odisha living in kutcha houses or single pucca room with monthly income below Rs 25,000.
nodal_ministry: Panchayati Raj and Drinking Water Department, Odisha

description_en: State health insurance scheme by Government of Kerala in convergence with PM-JAY providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospital treatment to vulnerable families.
description_hi: केरल के गरीब परिवारों को सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में गंभीर बीमारियों के इलाज हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस बीमा कवरेज।
benefits_en: Cashless hospitalization and critical surgery cover up to Rs 5 Lakh per family per year across government and private hospitals.
benefits_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का निःशुल्क कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार।
eligibility_criteria: BPL families and vulnerable households enrolled in the KASP health registry in Kerala.
nodal_ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Kerala

description_en: Internationally acclaimed poverty eradication and women empowerment mission by Government of Kerala promoting women-led microenterprises, cafe networks, and farming collectives.
description_hi: केरल में महिला स्वयं सहायता समूहों को सूक्ष्म उद्योग, कैंटीन और कृषि सामूहिक उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु शून्य ब्याज ऋण और पूंजीगत अनुदान।
benefits_en: Matching capital grants, interest-free microcredit loans, market outlets, and comprehensive technical skill training.
benefits_hi: पूंजीगत अनुदान, ब्याज-मुक्त सूक्ष्म ऋण और स्थानीय विपणन मंच।
eligibility_criteria: Women members of Neighborhood Groups (NHGs) registered under Kudumbashree Mission in Kerala.
nodal_ministry: Local Self Government Department, Kerala

description_en: Social welfare assistance scheme by Government of Punjab providing direct financial grants to low-income families belonging to SC, BC, and Economically Weaker Sections for the marriage of their daughters.
description_hi: पंजाब में अनुसूचित जाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹51,000 की सीधी वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits_en: One-time direct bank transfer of Rs 51,000 into the bride's bank account before or at the time of marriage.
benefits_hi: विवाह के समय ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता राशि सीधे बैंक खाते में।
eligibility_criteria: Residents of Punjab belonging to SC, BC, or EWS categories with family annual income not exceeding Rs 32,790.
nodal_ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab

description_en: Comprehensive health protection mission by Government of Haryana extending free cashless medical treatment up to Rs 5 Lakh per year to families with annual income up to Rs 3 Lakh.
description_hi: हरियाणा के ₹3 लाख तक वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा कार्ड।
benefits_en: Cashless hospitalization coverage of Rs 5 Lakh per family per year in over 700 empanelled government and private hospitals.
benefits_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का कैशलेस अस्पताल इलाज।
eligibility_criteria: Resident families of Haryana verified under Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with verified income up to Rs 3 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Health Department, Government of Haryana

description_en: Targeted mission by Government of Haryana to elevate poorest families having annual income below Rs 1 Lakh through dedicated skill training, self-employment loans, and wage subsidies.
description_hi: हरियाणा के ₹1 लाख से कम वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों की आय ₹1.80 लाख तक बढ़ाने हेतु स्वरोजगार ऋण और कौशल पैकेज।
benefits_en: Subsidized bank loans up to Rs 5 Lakh with up to 50% government subsidy (up to Rs 50,000) and guaranteed wage employment linkages.
benefits_hi: ₹5 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण तथा ₹50,000 तक की सरकारी सब्सिडी।
eligibility_criteria: Families identified in Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) database with verified annual family income below Rs 1 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Human Resources Department, Haryana

description_en: Largest direct cash transfer scheme in Northeast India by Government of Assam providing regular monthly financial support to women heads of vulnerable households to purchase medicines, pulses, and sugar.
description_hi: असम सरकार द्वारा गरीब परिवारों की महिला मुखिया को ₹1,250 प्रति माह की सीधी बैंक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct bank transfer of Rs 1,250 every month (Total Rs 15,000 per year) credited via DBT on the 10th of every month.
eligibility_criteria: Permanent residents of Assam whose household annual income is less than Rs 2 Lakh with priority for widows, divyangjan, and unmarried women.
nodal_ministry: Finance Department, Government of Assam

description_en: Comprehensive educational support scheme by Government of Assam offering completely free admission in government colleges, textbook allowances, and free scooters to meritorious girl students.
description_hi: असम में सरकारी कॉलेजों में 100% फ्री एडमिशन, ₹1,500 पाठ्यपुस्तक अनुदान और मेधावी छात्राओं को निःशुल्क स्कूटी।
benefits_en: 100% free admission from Higher Secondary to Post-Graduation, annual textbook grant of Rs 1,500, hostel mess subsidy of Rs 2,000/month, and free two-wheeler scooter for top rankers.
benefits_hi: निःशुल्क कॉलेज प्रवेश, ₹1,500 पुस्तक भत्ता और मेधावी छात्राओं को फ्री स्कूटी।
benefit_amount: Free College + Free Scooter for Meritorious Girls
eligibility_criteria: Students studying in government and provincialized colleges in Assam with parental income below Rs 2 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Higher Education Department, Government of Assam

title_en: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship (Jharkhand)
title_hi: मरांग गोमके जयपाल सिंह मुंडा विदेशी छात्रवृत्ति (झारखंड)
description_en: Prestige overseas scholarship by Government of Jharkhand funding full Master's and M.Phil degree programs in premier UK and Irish universities for ST, SC, OBC, and Minority scholars.
description_hi: झारखंड के अनुसूचित जनजाति, अनुसूचित जाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग एवं अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को ऑक्सफोर्ड, कैम्ब्रिज जैसे शीर्ष विश्वविद्यालयों में मास्टर्स हेतु 100% छात्रवृत्ति।
benefits_en: 100% tuition fees, annual living allowance up to £15,000, air travel, visa fees, and comprehensive medical insurance.
benefits_hi: 100% ट्यूशन फीस, £15,000 वार्षिक निर्वाह भत्ता, हवाई टिकट और वीजा शुल्क।
eligibility_criteria: Permanent residents of Jharkhand belonging to ST, SC, OBC, or Minority communities under 35 years of age with family income below Rs 12 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare Department, Jharkhand

description_en: Rural fruit orchard plantation and agro-forestry scheme by Government of Jharkhand providing 100 fruit-bearing plants, water harvesting pits, and wages under MGNREGA to rural families.
description_hi: झारखंड के ग्रामीण परिवारों को 1 एकड़ भूमि पर 100 फलदार पौधे (आम, अमरूद, नींबू) लगाने हेतु ₹50,000 तक की वार्षिक आय सहायता।
benefits_en: 100 free hybrid fruit saplings per acre, plant protection kits, fencing, water harvesting pits, and 3 years of guaranteed daily wages for maintenance.
benefits_hi: 100 निःशुल्क फलदार पौधे, खाद, कीटनाशक, तार-घेराबंदी और 3 वर्ष तक मनरेगा मजदूरी।
eligibility_criteria: Rural families and small farmers holding at least 0.5 to 1 acre of unused or fallow land in Jharkhand.
nodal_ministry: Rural Development Department, Jharkhand

description_en: Maternity financial assistance initiative by Government of Chhattisgarh providing a one-time grant to mothers upon the birth of a second girl child to promote female child education and nutrition.
description_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ में दूसरी बालिका के जन्म पर माता को पोषण और देखभाल हेतु ₹5,000 की एकमुश्त आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: One-time direct bank transfer of Rs 5,000 into the mother's bank account upon birth registration of the second female child.
benefits_hi: दूसरी बेटी के जन्म पर ₹5,000 की एकमुश्त सीधी सहायता राशि।
eligibility_criteria: Resident mothers of Chhattisgarh registered at Anganwadi centers upon institutional delivery of second daughter.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Chhattisgarh

description_en: State healthcare coverage initiative by Government of Himachal Pradesh providing cashless hospitalization up to Rs 5 Lakh per family per year to households not covered under Ayushman Bharat.
description_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश के उन सभी परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा जो आयुष्मान भारत के अंतर्गत शामिल नहीं हैं।
benefits_en: Cashless in-patient treatment and surgery cover up to Rs 5 Lakh per family per year across registered government and private hospitals.
benefits_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का निःशुल्क कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार।
eligibility_criteria: Domicile families of Himachal Pradesh not covered under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY or government employee schemes.
nodal_ministry: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Himachal Pradesh

description_en: Flagship youth enterprise development program by Government of Himachal Pradesh offering capital investment subsidies up to 35% on projects up to Rs 1 Crore for setting up new enterprises.
description_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश के युवाओं को उद्योग, होटल, पर्यटन और सर्विस सेक्टर में उद्यम लगाने हेतु 25% से 35% पूंजीगत सब्सिडी और 5% ब्याज छूट।
benefits_en: Capital subsidy of 25% for males, 30% for SC/ST, and 35% for Women/Divyangjan on project costs up to Rs 1 Crore, plus 5% interest subvention for 3 years.
benefits_hi: परियोजना लागत पर 25% से 35% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹35 लाख) और 5% ब्याज छूट।
eligibility_criteria: Resident youth of Himachal Pradesh aged 18 to 45 years (up to 50 years for women).
nodal_ministry: Department of Industries, Himachal Pradesh

description_en: Conditional cash incentive scheme by Government of Uttarakhand for girl students from BPL and marginalized families upon passing Class XII to promote college education.
description_hi: उत्तराखंड में 12वीं कक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने वाली गरीब बालिकाओं को उच्च शिक्षा हेतु ₹51,000 की प्रत्यक्ष आर्थिक सहायता।
benefits_en: Direct financial grant of Rs 51,000 transferred into the student's bank account upon passing Class 12 from state-recognized boards.
benefits_hi: 12वीं पास करने पर ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त छात्रवृत्ति/अनुदान राशि।
eligibility_criteria: Girl students belonging to SC, ST, and BPL families who have cleared Class 12 from recognized schools in Uttarakhand.
nodal_ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttarakhand

title_en: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana (Delhi)
title_hi: जय भीम मुख्यमंत्री प्रतिभा विकास योजना (दिल्ली)
description_en: Premier free competitive exam coaching scheme by Government of Delhi for SC, ST, OBC, and EWS students preparing for UPSC, SSC, Banking, JEE, NEET, and CLAT.
description_hi: दिल्ली के आरक्षित और गरीब वर्ग के छात्रों को प्रतिष्ठित निजी कोचिंग संस्थानों में 100% निःशुल्क कोचिंग एवं ₹2,500 प्रति माह स्टाइपेंड।
benefits_en: 100% coaching fees covered directly by Delhi Government plus a monthly living stipend of Rs 2,500 per student during the course duration.
benefits_hi: 100% निःशुल्क कोचिंग फीस भुगतान तथा ₹2,500 प्रति माह निर्वाह भत्ता।
eligibility_criteria: Students residing in Delhi belonging to SC, ST, OBC, or EWS categories who completed 10th and 12th in Delhi with family income up to Rs 8 Lakh.
nodal_ministry: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Government of Delhi

description_en: All-inclusive free pilgrimage travel scheme by Government of Delhi for senior citizens covering train travel in AC trains, AC hotel accommodation, meals, and local sightseeing.
description_hi: दिल्ली के 60 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को देश भर के प्रमुख तीर्थ स्थलों की 100% निःशुल्क एसी तीर्थ यात्रा।
benefits_en: 100% free Bharat Gaurav AC train travel, 3-star AC hotel stays, wholesome meals, insurance, and travel kits for the senior citizen and one younger attendant.
benefits_hi: पूर्णतः निःशुल्क यात्रा, एसी ट्रेन टिकट, होटल आवास, भोजन और मेडिकल बीमा।
eligibility_criteria: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above residing in Delhi who are not government employees and have not availed the scheme previously.
nodal_ministry: Tirth Yatra Vikas Samiti, Government of Delhi

title_en: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
title_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि योजना (स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि)
description_en: Micro-credit facility by Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors, hawkers, and cart operators.
description_hi: रेहड़ी-पटरी, ठेला और फुटपाथ विक्रेताओं को बिना किसी गारंटी के ₹10,000 से ₹50,000 तक का सस्ता कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण।
benefits_en: First tranche loan of Rs 10,000, second tranche of Rs 20,000, and third tranche up to Rs 50,000 with 7% annual interest subsidy and cashback of up to Rs 1,200/year on digital transactions.
benefits_hi: बिना गारंटी ₹10,000 से ₹50,000 तक का लोन, 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी और ₹1,200/वर्ष तक डिजिटल कैशबैक।
eligibility_criteria: Urban and peri-urban street vendors, hawkers, and sellers holding Vending Certificate or Letter of Recommendation.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title_hi: पीएम कुसुम योजना (सोलर कृषि पंप सब्सिडी)
description_en: Solar agriculture initiative providing 60% combined central and state subsidy to farmers for replacing diesel pumps with standalone off-grid or grid-connected solar water pumps.
description_hi: किसानों को डीजल पंप हटाकर सोलर पंप लगाने और अतिरिक्त सोलर बिजली ग्रिड को बेचकर कमाई करने हेतु 60% सरकारी सब्सिडी।
benefits_en: 60% government subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on solar pumps up to 10 HP with 30% bank loan and only 10% farmer contribution, plus income from surplus power sales.
benefits_hi: सोलर पंप की कीमत पर 60% तक की भारी सब्सिडी और ग्रिड को बिजली बेचकर अतिरिक्त कमाई।
eligibility_criteria: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs, and water user associations having agricultural land and irrigation water source.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
